scope: human v002, hair01 back/front, face01: 14 clips each
observations: Bald base has no painted eyes, mouth or hair. Skin and scarf key masks are separate.
All head components share frame attachment and rotation. KO head was shifted toward the torso to close a visible gap.
Hair bangs were shortened upward to reveal face01 eyes. Rounded eye corners replace the first square-eye trial.
World left/right are separate exported clips; symmetric head components use mirrored view registration while body poses retain the original directional animation.
Up-facing face is intentionally transparent. Front cap covers the opaque bald skull in the renderer's fixed draw order.
60 skin/hair combinations preserve the outfit's gold and purple material colours; reserved keys are excluded from ordinary palette mapping.
